title: Why are three of the UK’s four nuclear deterrent submarines at sea?
english: The United Kingdom has deployed three of its four nuclear-armed submarines at once, a rare occurrence that has not happened in five years. While the government maintains that its nuclear deterrent is vital for national security, this unusual move follows recent warnings from officials about the need to prepare for potential conflict. Experts suggest that while one boat handles regular patrol duties, the others are likely engaged in training exercises or preparations to relieve existing patrols.

title: The next phase of military rule in Egypt is here
english: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has declared he will step down at the end of his third term in 2030, rejecting speculation that he would seek to change the constitution to stay in power. This unexpected announcement has raised questions about whether he is genuinely preparing for a transition or simply managing political pressure. Analysts believe this move might signal a new phase of military-led governance, especially given the significant economic challenges and potential legal risks he could face after leaving office.

title: Experts defer to AI in decision-making, Anthropic study finds
english: A recent study by Anthropic reveals that professional analysts are highly likely to rely on AI recommendations, often mirroring the suggestions of their digital assistants 86 percent of the time. Even when experts held an initial opinion, they frequently abandoned it when the AI expressed a conflicting view. Despite this strong influence, the majority of participants failed to acknowledge the AI as the source of their reasoning when justifying their final choices.

title: ‘Working our fingers to the bone’: Can the UK save its struggling high streets?
english: Small business owners in the UK are struggling to stay open as rising operational costs like rent, energy, and taxes put immense pressure on their profits. title: Netanyahu outlines achievements, future plans as Likud leads Israeli polls
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is leading in recent elections, with his Likud party projected to become the largest in parliament. While his bloc holds a significant lead, he still lacks a clear majority to form a government and will likely need to negotiate a coalition. Netanyahu emphasized his record of neutralizing regional adversaries and stated that a right-wing coalition is essential for Israel's future security.

title: Netanyahu's bloc leads at 55 seats, but short of majority vote
english: Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition is currently leading in the Israeli elections with 55 seats, though it has fallen short of the majority needed to govern. Gadi Eisenkot’s group follows with 49 seats, while Arab parties hold 16. These results are preliminary, as only about half of the total votes have been counted so far.

title: Ra’am leader accuses Netanyahu of ‘lying and inciting’ against Arab party
english: Mansour Abbas, the leader of the Ra'am party, has rejected claims made by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu regarding election fraud. Netanyahu had alleged that members of the Arab party were attempting to manipulate the vote, but election officials found no proof to support these accusations. Abbas argues that these claims are intended to provoke voters and manipulate public opinion to benefit Netanyahu's political goals.
amharic: የራአም ፓርቲ መሪ ማንሱር አባስ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በፓርቲያቸው ላይ ያቀረቡትን የምርጫ ማጭበርበር ክስ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ኔታንያሁ የፓርቲው አባላት ድምፅ ለመስረቅ እንደሞከሩ ቢከሱም፣ የምርጫ ባለስልጣናት ይህን የሚያረጋግጥ ማስረጃ አላገኙም። አባስ እንደሚሉት ከሆነ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ እነዚህን ውንጀላዎች የተጠቀሙት የራሳቸውን ደጋፊዎች ለማነሳሳት እና በፓርቲያቸው ላይ ጥላቻን ለመፍጠር ነው።
oromo: Manni maree paartii Ra’am, Mansour Abbas, himata sobaa kan pirezidaantii Israa’el Biniyamin Netanyaahuu paartii isaarratti dhiyeessan mormaniiru. Netanyaahuun miseensonni paartii Arabaa filannoo hatuuf yaalaniiru jechuun himatanis, abbootiin taayitaa filannoo himata kanaaf ragaa kamiyyuu dhabaniiru. Abbas akka jedhanitti, himanni kun kan dhiyaate deggertoota Netanyaahuu kakaasuuf fi paartii isaarratti jibba uumuuf qofa dha.

title: More than 2.7 million votes counted, Palestinian-led parties overtake Bennett’s Together alliance at third place
english: Following the counting of over 2.7 million votes in Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc maintains a lead despite a minor drop in projected seats. Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar party currently sits in second place. Notably, Palestinian-led parties have moved into third, surpassing Naftali Bennett’s Together alliance.
amharic: በእስራኤል ከ2.7 ሚሊዮን በላይ ድምፆች ከተቆጠሩ በኋላ የቢንያም ኔታንያሁ ቡድን የመሪነቱን ቦታ ይዞ ቀጥሏል። የጋዲ አይዘንኮት የያሻር ፓርቲ በሁለተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ሲሆን፣ የፍልስጤም መሪዎች የሚመሩት ጥምረት ደግሞ የናፍታሊ ቤኔትን የቱጌዘር ጥምረት በመቅደም በሶስተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ተቀምጠዋል።
oromo: Israa'el keessatti sagaleen miiliyoona 2.7 ol erga lakka'amee booda, gareen Binyaam Netaanyaahuu fooyyee qabaatus dursaa jira. Paartiin Gadii Ayizenkoo kan Yaashaar jedhamu sadarkaa lammaffaa irratti argama. Kana malees, paartiileen Filaasxeemotaan durfaman garee Naaftaalli Beeneet kan 'Together' jedhamu caaluudhaan sadarkaa sadaffaa irratti argamu.

title: Trump claims his backing of Netanyahu reversed his 'decisive defeat' in Israeli elections
english: Former President Donald Trump asserted that his political support for Benjamin Netanyahu significantly changed the outcome of Israel's elections. He claimed that his endorsement prevented a major loss for the Prime Minister and instead shifted the results toward a potential victory or a tie. Trump emphasized that his intervention was intended to benefit the stability of both Israel and the United States.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ለቢንያም ኔታንያሁ የሰጡት ድጋፍ የእስራኤልን የምርጫ ውጤት በአዎንታዊ መልኩ እንደቀየረው ተናግረዋል። ትራምፕ እንደሚሉት፣ ድጋፋቸው ለኔታንያሁ ሊደርስባቸው የነበረውን ከባድ ሽንፈት አስቀርቶ ወደ ድል ወይም አቻ ውጤት እንዲመጡ አድርጓቸዋል። ይህ ድጋፍ ለእስራኤል፣ ለአሜሪካ እና ለመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ሰላም አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii duraanii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp deeggarsi isaanii Binyaam Netaaniyaahuuf kennan bu'aa filannoo Israa'eel jijjiiruuf gargaareera jedhaniiru. Traamp akka jedhanitti, deeggarsi isaanii kun injifannoo dhabuu Netaaniyaahuu hambisee, bu'aa filannichaa gara injifannootti ykn qixxaatti akka jijjiirame dubbataniiru. Deeggarsi kun Israa'eel, Ameerikaafi guutummaa biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaatiif gaariidha jedhaniiru.

title: Arab parties could win 18 Israeli parliament seats
english: Early exit polls from Israel's recent election indicate that Arab-led parties could secure a historic 18 seats in parliament. This result follows a record-breaking 80 percent voter turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel. As the main political blocs remain deadlocked, these parties are now in a crucial position to influence the formation of the next government.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የእስራኤል ምርጫ መጀመሪያ ውጤቶች መሠረት፣ የአረብ ተወላጅ ፓርቲዎች በፓርላማ ታሪካዊ በሆነ መንገድ 18 መቀመጫዎችን ሊያገኙ እንደሚችሉ ታይቷል። ይህ ውጤት የመጣው በሀገሪቱ በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ዘንድ ከ80 በመቶ በላይ የሆነ ከፍተኛ የምርጫ ተሳትፎ በመመዝገቡ ነው። ዋና ዋናዎቹ የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች አቻ ውጤት በማምጣታቸው፣ እነዚህ ፓርቲዎች የሚቀጥለውን መንግስት ለመመስረት በሚደረገው ሂደት ወሳኝ ሚና ይኖራቸዋል።
oromo: Bu'aan duraa filannoo Israa'el akka agarsiisutti, paartileen Arabaa bakka bu'an seenaa keessatti si'a jalqabaatiif teessoo 18 paarlaamaa keessatti argachuu danda'u. Bu'aan kun kan dhufe lammileen Israa'el kan ta'an Falasxiinonni hedduun harka 80 ol ta'uun filannicharratti hirmaachuu isaaniitiin. Gareewwan siyaasaa gurguddoon wal-qixxaachuu isaaniitiin, paartileen kunneen mootummaa itti aanu hundeesuuf murteessaa ta'anii jiru.

title: Exit polls trigger heated debate across Israeli political divide
english: Israel's recent exit polls indicate a deadlocked election between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition and the opposition led by Gadi Eisenkot, with neither side securing the 61 seats needed for a majority. While opposition leaders are framing the results as a significant rejection of the current government, Netanyahu's allies argue that it is too early to declare a outcome. The final government formation will likely depend on the 18 seats held by unaligned Arab parties, who are now positioned as key players in upcoming coalition talks.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜው የእስራኤል የምርጫ ውጤት ትንበያ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና በተቃዋሚ መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት መካከል አቻ ውጤት አሳይቷል። ሁለቱም ወገኖች መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስፈልገውን የ61 መቀመጫዎች ድጋፍ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። ተቃዋሚዎች ውጤቱን የገዥው አካል ሽንፈት እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ የኔታንያሁ ደጋፊዎች ግን የመጨረሻ ውጤት ሳይታወቅ መደምደም አይቻልም በማለት ይከራከራሉ። የመንግስት ምስረታው በአረብ ፓርቲዎች እጅ የወደቀ ሲሆን፣ እነሱም የትኛውን ወገን እንደሚደግፉ ወሳኝ ሚና ይጫወታሉ።
oromo: Bu'aan ba'ii filannoo Israa'el kan agarsiisu gamtaan Muummee Ministiraa Benjamin Netanyahu fi mormitoonni Gadi Eisenkotin geggeeffaman wal qixxee ta'uu isaanii ti; lamaanuu teessoo 61 kan mootummaa hundeessuuf barbaachisu argachuu hin dandeenye. Hogganoonni mormituu bu'aa kana akka injifannoo guddaa fi mormii mootummaa ammaa irratti mul'ateetti yoo lakka'an, deggertonni Netanyahu garuu hanga bu'aan xumuraa ifa ta'utti mariin dura akka ta'e dubbatu. Hunda'iinsi mootummaa gara fuulduraa kan hundaa'u paartilee Arabootaatiin yoo ta'u, isaanis marii kootaaliishinii irratti murteessitoota ta'u.

title: ‘This is America’: US envoy scolds Cuban diplomat at UN
english: A tense confrontation occurred at the United Nations in New York between a US envoy and Cuban representatives. During a session regarding the ongoing US trade embargo and fuel blockade against Cuba, the American diplomat repeatedly confronted the Cuban team by stating 'This is America.' The clash highlighted the deepening diplomatic friction between the two nations.
amharic: በኒውዮርክ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና መስሪያ ቤት በአሜሪካ እና በኩባ ዲፕሎማቶች መካከል ከፍተኛ የቃላት ግጭት ተፈጥሯል። የአሜሪካው ልዑክ በኩባ ላይ የተጣለውን የንግድ እገዳ እና የነዳጅ ማዕቀብ በተመለከተ በተካሄደው ውይይት ላይ የኩባን ቡድን በተደጋጋሚ 'ይህ አሜሪካ ናት' በማለት ተናግረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Nyuuyorkitti bakka waajjira gamtaa mootummootaatti, ergamtoota Ameerikaafi Kuubaa gidduutti walitti bu’iinsi cimaan uumameera. Ergamtuun Ameerikaa dhimma daldalaafi dhiyeessii boba’aa irratti Kuubaa irratti godhame irratti marii taasifamaa ture irratti, garee Kuubaa 'kun Ameerikaadha' jechuun irra deddeebi’ee dubbateera. Walitti bu’iinsi kun hariiroo dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru kan dhipheesse ta’uun ibsameera.

title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
english: A ceasefire in the Kherson region of Ukraine has been expanded to allow humanitarian aid to reach trapped residents in the city of Oleshky. The truce, brokered with the help of Melania Trump, has stopped military hostilities and will facilitate food and medicine deliveries. Authorities plan to organize evacuations for remaining civilians by Friday, with the agreement set to last until November 1.
amharic: በዩክሬን የኬርሰን ክልል ለተጎጂዎች የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እንዲደርስ የተደረገው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ተስፋፍቷል። በሜላኒያ ትራምፕ ጥረት የተደረሰው ይህ ስምምነት ወታደራዊ ግጭቶችን በማስቆም የምግብ እና የህክምና ቁሳቁሶች ወደ ኦሌሽኪ ከተማ እንዲገቡ ያስችላል። ባለስልጣናት አርብ ዕለት ሲቪሎችን ለማስወጣት እቅድ የያዙ ሲሆን ስምምነቱ እስከ ህዳር 1 ድረስ እንደሚቆይ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Godina Kherson kan Yukreen keessatti walitti buiinsi waraanaa dhaabbatee gargaarsi namoomaa jiraattota magaalaa Oleshky keessatti harkifamaniif akka ga'u godhameera. Marii Melaniya Trump qindeessaniin, waraanni dhaabbatee nyaanniifi qorichi gara magaalattii akka galu carraan banameera. Aangeyyoonni guyyaa Jimaata jiraattota bakka sanaa baasuuf karoorfataniiru; walii galteen kunis hanga Sadaasa 1tti akka turu ibsameera.

title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard
english: A veteran zookeeper in the Netherlands has passed away after being attacked by two Persian leopards inside their enclosure. The long-time employee suffered critical injuries while caring for the animals during poor weather and later died in the hospital. The safari park is investigating the incident, though they have stated the leopards were acting on natural instincts and will not be put down.
amharic: በኔዘርላንድስ የሚገኝ መካነ አራዊት ሰራተኛ በሁለት የፋርስ ነብሮች ጥቃት ደርሶባት ህይወቷ አልፏል። ለረጅም ዓመታት በዚያው መካነ አራዊት ስትሰራ የቆየችው ሰራተኛዋ፣ የአየር ሁኔታው መጥፎ በመሆኑ እንስሳቱን ወደ ውስጥ ስታስገባ በደረሰባት ጥቃት ከባድ ጉዳት ደርሶባት በህክምና ላይ እያለች ነው የሞተችው። መካነ አራዊቱ በአደጋው ላይ ምርመራ እየጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ነብሮቹ የተፈጥሮ ባህሪያቸውን ስላሳዩ እንዳልተገደሉ አስታውቋል።
oromo: ጂኦሎጂስት (zoologist) biyya Nezerlaandi tokko bineensa leeypardii jedhamuun erga miidhamtee booda lubbuun ishee darbeera. Hojjetttuun kun qilleensa hamaa hordofee bineensota kana gara ganda isaanii galchuuf yaaltu irratti leeypardoonni kun miidhaa cimaa irraan ga'aniiru; isheenis hospitaala keessatti yeroo yaalamaa turte du'eera. Paarkiin kun qorannoo geggeessaa jiru yoo ta'u, leeypardoonni kun amala isaanii uumamaa waan agarsiisaniif akka hin ajjeefamne ibseera.

title: Flavio Bolsonaro flees Brazil after election loss, US says will grant visa
english: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro has reportedly left for the United States following his defeat in the presidential election. This departure occurs amid a Supreme Court investigation into money laundering allegations against him, which included a request for him to surrender his passport. The U.S. government has confirmed it will grant visas to the senator and his family, a move criticized by President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.
amharic: የብራዚል ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ ከተሸነፉ በኋላ ወደ አሜሪካ መሄዳቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህ ጉዞ የተደረገው በሳቸው ላይ በገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል የተጀመረ ምርመራ እና የጉዞ መረጃቸውን እንዲያስረክቡ የታዘዘበት ወቅት ነው። የአሜሪካ መንግስት ለሴናተሩ እና ለቤተሰቦቻቸው ቪዛ እንደሚሰጥ ያረጋገጠ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ድርጊት በፕሬዚዳንት ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ትችት ቀርቦበታል።
oromo: Senatoriin biyya Brazil Flavio Bolsonaro filannoo pirezidaantummaa irratti erga injifataman booda gara Ameerikaa imaluun gabaasameera. Imalli kun kan ta'e otoo inni shakkii yakka maallaqa waliin walqabatuun qorannoo irra jiruufi paspoortii isaa akka kennu mana murtiitiin ajajamee jiruu dha. Mootummaan Ameerikaa senatorichaa fi maatii isaatiif viizaa akka kennu kan mirkaneesse yoo ta'u, gochi kun pirezidaant Lula da Silva biratti mormii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Trump showcases Venezuelan oil as he seeks to rally voters in Texas
english: President Trump showcased a tanker in Texas that he claims is carrying one million barrels of Venezuelan oil as part of a victory following military intervention in that country. He is using this shipment to address voter concerns over high fuel costs caused by the ongoing war with Iran ahead of the midterm elections. While the President describes this as a major energy gain, experts remain skeptical about the short-term economic benefits of the deal.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በቴክሳስ በሚገኘው የዘይት መርከብ በመጠቀም ከቬንዙዌላ ጋር በተደረገው ወታደራዊ ድል የተገኘውን አንድ ሚሊዮን በርሜል ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ አስተዋውቀዋል። ይህንንም እርምጃ የወሰዱት በኢራን ጦርነት ምክንያት እየጨመረ የመጣውን የነዳጅ ዋጋ በመቀነስ መራጮችን ለማሳመን ነው። ምንም እንኳን ትራምፕ ይህንን እንደ ትልቅ ድል ቢገልጹትም፣ ባለሙያዎች ግን የዚህ ስምምነት ለአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ ባለው አስተዋጽኦ ላይ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp Teeksaasitti doonii gurguddaa boba'aa Veenezueelaarraa dhufe jedhamee yaadamu agarsiisuun, injifannoo waraana biyyattii irratti argame ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatamee jiru, waraana Iraan waliin jiruun walqabatee gatiin boba'aa dabaluun isaa filattoota irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeef, isaaniif furmaata kennuufi. Pireezidaantichi injifannoo kana galata guddaa jedhanii kan ibsan ta'us, ogeeyyonni garuu faayidaan kun yeroo gabaabaa keessatti qabeenya biyyattiif bu'aa qabaachuu isaa irratti shakkii qabu.

title: Forever Wars: Why can’t America stop?
english: The United States remains entangled in ongoing Middle Eastern conflicts despite widespread public opposition. Experts are debating whether these persistent wars are driven by economic interests like the massive defense industry, lobbying efforts, or systemic political flaws. The discussion highlights the difficulty voters face in holding leaders accountable and ending these long-term military engagements.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ህዝባዊ ተቃውሞ ቢኖርም በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በጦርነት ውስጥ መዘፈቁን ቀጥሏል። የጦር መሳሪያ ኢንዱስትሪው ጥቅም፣ የሎቢ ቡድኖች ተጽዕኖ እና የፖለቲካ ስርዓቱ ድክመት ለዚህ ተደጋጋሚ ጦርነት እንደ መንስኤ ይጠቀሳሉ። መራጮች በእነዚህ የረጅም ጊዜ ጦርነቶች ላይ ተጽዕኖ ማሳደር እንደሚችሉ እና መሪዎችን ተጠያቂ ማድረግ እንደሚችሉ ጥያቄዎች እየተነሱ ነው።
oromo: Amerika mormii ummataa bal'aa jiraatu illee naannoo Baha Giddu galeessatti waraana keessa seenuu itti fufteetti. Oggeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, waraanni kun faayidaa dinagdee kanneen akka warshaalee meeshaa waraanaa, dhiibbaa garee morkatootaa fi hanqina sirna siyaasaa irraa kan madde ta'uu dubbatu. Dhimmi kun filattoonni waraana kana dhaabsisuufi hogganoota itti gaafatamtoota taasisuuf hammam akka dhibamu ibsa.

title: Will players in the Gulf establish a new security framework?
english: High-ranking officials from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Turkey, and Iran have gathered in Tehran for urgent talks aimed at reducing regional tensions. This meeting is seen as a critical opportunity to prevent further conflict amidst threats of potential military action between Iran, the United States, and Israel. The participants are exploring whether these regional powers can collaborate to establish a more stable security environment in the Gulf.
amharic: ከሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ፣ ከፓኪስታን፣ ከቱርክ እና ከኢራን የተውጣጡ ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣናት በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ በሚል በቴህራን ተሰብስበዋል። ይህ ስብሰባ በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ሊቀሰቀስ የሚችለውን ወታደራዊ ግጭት ለመከላከል እንደ ትልቅ ዕድል ታይቷል። ስብሰባው የክልሉ አገራት በጋራ በመስራት በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ የተረጋጋ የጸጥታ ማዕቀፍ መፍጠር ይችሉ እንደሆነ ለመገምገም ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo biyyoota Saudi Arabiyaa, Paakistaan, Turkii fi Iraan rakkoo naannichaa tasgabbeessuuf magaala Teheranitti walgahaniiru. Walgahii kana kan taasisan walitti bu’iinsa biyyoota Iraan, Ameerikaa fi Israa’el gidduutti uumamuu malu ittisuufi. Biyyoonni kunneen naannichatti nageenya buusuufi rakkoo isaan mudachaa jiru mariin furuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Dream postponed: Hebron groom caught in Israeli military lockdown
english: A Palestinian man named Haidar Yahya Tamimi was forced to postpone his wedding after Israeli military forces placed the city of Hebron under a strict lockdown. Following a fatal attack on soldiers, thousands of residents, including Haidar and his family, were ordered to evacuate their homes. The couple had spent months preparing for their marriage, but their celebration has been indefinitely delayed as they remain displaced.
amharic: ሃይዳር ያህያ ታሚሚ የተባለ ፍልስጤማዊ ወጣት፣ እስራኤል በሄብሮን ከተማ ላይ ባወጀችው ጥብቅ የእንቅስቃሴ ገደብ ምክንያት ሰርጉን ለሌላ ጊዜ ማስተላለፍ ተገዷል። በከተማዋ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ምክንያት እስራኤል ባካሄደችው ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን፣ ሃይዳርን ጨምሮ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲወጡ ተደርገዋል። ጥንዶቹ ለወራት ያዘጋጁት የሠርግ ዝግጅት በድንገተኛው መፈናቀል ምክንያት ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ ተቋርጧል።
oromo: dargaggeessi Filisxeemii Hayidar Yahyaa Taamimii jedhamu, waraanni Israa'el magaalaa Heebroon keessatti labsiin yeroo waraanaa waan labsameef cidha isaa dheeressuuf dirqameera. Haleellaa loltoota irratti raawwatameen booda, Israa'el tarkaanfii fudhatteen Hayidarifi maatiin isaa dabalatee namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman mana isaanii gadi lakkisanii akka ba'an ajajamanii jiru. Hiriyoonni gaa'elaa kunneen ji'ootaaf qophii cidha isaanii gochaa turanis, buqqa'uu isaaniitiin walqabatee guyyaan cidha isaanii yeroo hin murtoofneef dabree jira.

title: Joint List leader says voters sent clear message to ‘government of bloodshed’
english: Yousef Jabareen, a prominent figure in the Joint List, described the recent Israeli election as a historic moment for his political group. He stated that the high voter turnout clearly signals public opposition to the current leadership, which he labeled a government of bloodshed. Jabareen emphasized that his party is a vital political force whose influence is essential for any future governing efforts.
amharic: የጆይንት ሊስት መሪ ዩሴፍ ጃባሪን የቅርብ ጊዜውን የእስራኤል ምርጫ ለቡድናቸው ታሪካዊ ክስተት ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ከፍተኛ የምርጫ ተሳትፎ አሁን ያለው መንግስት ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው በግልጽ የሚያሳይ መልእክት ነው ብለዋል። አክለውም የእሳቸው ፓርቲ ችላ ሊባል የማይችል ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ኃይል በመሆኑ፣ ያለ እነሱ ተሳትፎ የወደፊት የፖለቲካ ሂደት መገንባት እንደማይቻል አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni 'Joint List' kan ta'an Yuusef Jaabareen, filannoo Israa'el darbe dhaabbata isaaniitiif guyyaa seena qabeessa jedhaniiru. Namoonni hedduun sagalee kennuun isaanii, mootummaan amma jiru fudhatama akka hin qabne ifatti mul'isa jechuun ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, paartiin isaanii humna siyaasaa guddaa waan ta'eef, hirmaannaa isaaniin alatti gara fuulduraatti mootummaan uumamu akka hin danda'amne ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli far-right minister says Eisenkot-led government would ‘paralyse’ his party’s work
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has warned that a government led by Gadi Eisenkot would obstruct his party's policy goals. Ben-Gvir expressed satisfaction with his own party's performance, as they are expected to secure several seats in the new parliament. His remarks highlight growing political friction as the country navigates the formation of a new government following recent elections.
amharic: የእስራኤል ብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር፣ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት የሚመራው መንግሥት የፓርቲያቸውን ሥራ እንደሚያደናቅፍ ገለጹ። ቤን-ግቪር በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ምርጫ ፓርቲያቸው ያስመዘገበውን ውጤት በማድነቅ በፓርላማ ውስጥ በርካታ መቀመጫዎችን እንደሚያገኙ ተናግረዋል። ይህ አስተያየታቸው አዲስ መንግሥት ለመመስረት በሚደረገው ሂደት ውስጥ በፖለቲከኞች መካከል ያለውን አለመግባባት ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministirri nageenya biyyaa Israa'el Itamaar Ben-Gviir, mootummaan Gadii Ayizenkootiin durfamu hojii paartii isaa akka gufachiisu dubbataniiru. Ben-Gviir bu'aa filannoo kanaan paartin isaa iddoo gahaa akka argatu ibsuun, gama kanaan quufuu isaa ibseera. Yaadni kun erga filannoon geggeeffamee booda hundeeffama mootummaa haaraa irratti jijjiirama siyaasaa fi wal dhabdee mul'achaa jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Israeli exit polls show huge Palestinian gains block Netanyahu from forming government
english: Recent exit polls in Israel indicate that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his opponents are both struggling to secure a majority in the Knesset. This political deadlock is largely due to a historic increase in voter turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel, whose representatives have gained significant parliamentary seats. Consequently, neither side currently possesses the sixty-one seats necessary to establish a new governing coalition.
amharic: በእስራኤል የተደረገው የድምፅ መስጫ ውጤት እንደሚያሳየው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁም ሆኑ ተቃዋሚዎቻቸው መንግሥት ለመመስረት የሚያስችል አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘት ተቸግረዋል። ይህ የሆነው በእስራኤል የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ዜጎች ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ባለው ድምፅ በመሳተፋቸው የተወካዮቻቸው ቁጥር በፓርላማ በታሪክ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ በመድረሱ ነው። በውጤቱም ሁለቱም ወገኖች መንግሥት ለማቋቋም የሚያስፈልገውን የ61 መቀመጫዎች ድጋፍ ማግኘት አልቻሉም።
oromo: bu'aan sagalee kennuu Israa'el keessatti mul'ate akka ibsuutti, Ministirri Mummee Benyaamiin Netaaniyaahuus ta'e morkattoonni isaanii mootummaa dhaabuuf sagalee gahaa argachuu hin dandeenye. Kun kan ta'eef lammiileen Israa'el kan ta'an Falasxiinonni baay'inaan sagalee kennuudhaan bakka buutonni isaanii baay'inaan paarlaamaa seenuu danda'aniiru. Kanaafuu, gareen lamaanuu mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf sagalee 61 kan barbaachisu argachuu hin dandeenye.

title: Palestinian voter mobilisation a ‘truly historic development’, analyst says
english: A political analyst has labeled the high voter turnout among Palestinian citizens in Israel as a historic move against current government policies. These voters are seeking to challenge ongoing violence in Gaza and the West Bank while pushing for a departure from the country's current path. The outcome of this mobilization is viewed as a critical opportunity to move away from systemic discrimination and toward a more ethical future.
amharic: የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች በእስራኤል የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን ዜጎች በከፍተኛ ቁጥር ድምጽ መስጠታቸውን አሁን ባለው የመንግስት ፖሊሲ ላይ የተደረገ ታሪካዊ እርምጃ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። እነዚህ መራጮች በጋዛ እና በዌስት ባንክ እየደረሰ ያለውን ጥቃት ለመቃወም እና አገሪቱ ከምትከተለው አደገኛ የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ለመውጣት እየጣሩ ነው። ይህ የምርጫ ተሳትፎም ስርአታዊ መድልዎን በማስቀረት ወደ ተሻለ የሞራል እና የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ለመሸጋገር እንደ ወሳኝ እድል ይታያል።

Namoonni kun miidhaa Gaazaafi Bahaa Irdos keessatti raawwatamaa jiru mormuudhaan, biyyattii karaa siyaasaa badaa irraa gara gara baasuuf carraaqaa jiru. Hirmaannaan kun loogii fi gidiraa hawaasummaa dhaabuu fi gara jijjiirama siyaasaa sirrii ta'eetti cehuuf carraa guddaa akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Veteran commentator says results mark ‘end of the Netanyahu era’
english: Political analyst Meron Rapoport claims the recent election results signal the conclusion of Benjamin Netanyahu’s time as prime minister. Although Netanyahu's Likud party remains the largest, he lacks enough parliamentary support to secure a governing majority. Political leaders may now prioritize forming a new coalition to prevent the uncertainty of holding additional elections.
amharic: የፖለቲካ ተንታኙ ሜሮን ራፖፖርት የቅርብ ጊዜ የምርጫ ውጤቶች የቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትርነት ዘመን ማብቂያ ማሳያ እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል። የኔታንያሁ ሊኩድ ፓርቲ በአብላጫ መቀመጫ አሸናፊ ቢሆንም፣ መንግሥት ለመመስረት የሚያስችል በቂ ድጋፍ ማግኘት አልቻለም። የሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ መሪዎች ሌላ ምርጫ እንዳይካሄድ ለመከላከል ጥምር መንግሥት ለመመሥረት ሊገደዱ ይችላሉ።
oromo: xiinxalaan siyaasaa Meron Rapoport bu'aan filannoo amma dhufe xumura yeroo aangoo Benjamin Netanyahu kan agarsiisu ta'uu ibseera. Paartiin Likud jedhamu kan Netanyahu hanga ammaatti caalma qabaatus, mootummaa hundeessuuf gargaarsa gahaa hin qabu. Hogganoonni siyaasaa biyyattii filannoo biraa irraa bilisa ta'uuf jecha wal ta'iinsa mootummaa hundeessuuf carraaquu danda'u.

title: Ballon d'Or ceremony raises case of French sports journalist jailed in Algeria
english: The Ballon d'Or ceremony in London drew global attention to the case of French sports journalist Christophe Gleizes, who is currently serving a seven-year prison sentence in Algeria. Arrested while reporting on a football club in the Kabylie region, Gleizes was accused of supporting terrorism due to his journalistic contacts. Presenters at the awards event advocated for his freedom, highlighting that his detention is widely considered an unjust crackdown on his professional work.
amharic: በለንደን በተካሄደው የባሎንዶር ሽልማት ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ በአልጄሪያ የሰባት ዓመት እስር የተፈረደበት የፈረንሳይ ስፖርት ጋዜጠኛ ክሪስቶፍ ግሌይዝ ጉዳይ ትኩረት አግኝቷል። ጋዜጠኛው በካቢሊ ክልል በሚገኝ የእግር ኳስ ክለብ ላይ ዘገባ ለመስራት በሄደበት ወቅት ከአሸባሪነት ጋር በተያያዘ ተጠርጥሮ መታሰሩ ይታወሳል። የሽልማቱ አዘጋጆች እና አቅራቢዎች ለጋዜጠኛው ያላቸውን ድጋፍ በመግለጽ፣ እስሩ የሙያ ነጻነትን የሚጋፋ መሆኑን በመጠቆም እንዲለቀቅ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Sirni badhaasa Ballon d'Or magaalaa Londonitti gaggeeffame, gaazexeessaa ispoortii Faransaay Christophe Gleizes biyya Aljeeriyaatti hidhaa waggaa torbaatitti muramee jiru irratti xiyyeeffannoo uumeera. Gaazexeessichi naannoo Kabiliitti kilabii kubbaa miilaa tokko irratti gabaasa hojjechaa osoo jiruu, quunnamtii inni qabuun walqabatee shororkeessummaa deggeruun himatamee hidhame. Qindeessitootni sirnichaas hojiin gaazexeessummaa isaa sirrii ta'uu ibsuun, hidhaan isaa kan hin malle ta'uu himuudhaan akka inni gadhiifamu gaafataniiru.

title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
english: Football star Kylian Mbappé has issued an apology after making an insensitive remark about the late Chinese leader Mao Zedong during a television interview. His comments triggered significant backlash in China, leading several brands to end their partnerships with him. Both Mbappé and Spain's La Liga have expressed regret, acknowledging that the joke caused deep offense to many people.
amharic: የእግር ኳስ ኮከቡ ኪሊያን ምባፔ በቻይና የቀድሞ መሪ ማኦ ዜዱንግ ላይ በሰጠው አግባብነት የለሽ አስተያየት ሳቢያ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። ይህ ንግግሩ በቻይና ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞን በማስነሳቱ ምክንያት በርካታ ኩባንያዎች ከእርሱ ጋር የነበራቸውን የንግድ ትብብር አቋርጠዋል። ምባፔም ሆነ የስፔን ላ ሊጋ፣ ይህ ቀልድ በብዙ ሰዎች ላይ ስሜታዊ ጉዳት ማድረሱን በመገንዘብ ጥልቅ መጸጸታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Taphataan kubbaa miilaa Kiliyan Mbappe, waayee hogganaa Chaayinaa durii Mao Zedong irratti ibsa miira namoota hedduu tuqu erga kenne booda dhiifama gaafateera. Ibsi kun Chaayinaa keessatti mormii guddaa kaasuu isaatiin walqabatee, dhaabbileen gurguddoon hedduun waliigaltee isaanii isa waliin akka dhaaban godheera. Mbappeenis ta'e liiguun ispaaniyaa (La Liga), qoosni kun namoota hedduu akka miidhe hubachuun gaabbii guddaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Russia jails IT worker for 13 years for donating money to Ukraine
english: A Russian military court sentenced an IT specialist, Yuri Belenkiy, to 13 years in prison for donating cryptocurrency to support the Ukrainian military. The conviction relied on transaction records provided by the cryptocurrency exchange Binance to Russian authorities. Belenkiy, who maintains his innocence, plans to appeal the decision after being accused of funding a group labeled as a terrorist organization by Russia.
amharic: የሩሲያ ወታደራዊ ፍርድ ቤት ለዩክሬን ጦር በዲጂታል ገንዘብ (ክሪፕቶ ከረንሲ) ድጋፍ አድርጓል በሚል ዩሪ ቤሌንኪ የተባሉ የቴክኖሎጂ ባለሙያ ላይ የ13 ዓመት እስራት ፈርዷል። የፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔ የተመሰረተው የክሪፕቶ ከረንሲ መገበያያ ድርጅት የሆነው ባይናንስ ለሩሲያ ምርመራ ቡድን ባቀረበው የመረጃ ልውውጥ ነው። ተከሳሹ ወንጀሉን በመካድ ይግባኝ እንደሚጠይቁ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በሩሲያ አሸባሪ ተብሎ በተፈረጀ ቡድን ላይ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ አድርገዋል በሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸው ነበር።
oromo: Mana murtii waraanaa Raashiyaa, Yuri Belenkiy kan jedhaman ogeessa teeknoolojii, torbee Ukraine gargaaruuf qarshii dijitaalaa (cryptocurrency) waan erganiif hidha waggaa 13 itti murteesse. Murtii kana irratti ragaan ijoo kan ta'e, gabaasa gurgurtaa qarshii dijitaalaa 'Binance' jedhamuun qorattoota Raashiyaaf dhiyaate dha. Belenkiy yakka kana haaluun ol-iyyannoo galfachuuf kan karoorfate yoo ta'u, Raashiyaan garee inni gargaare jedhamu sun garee shororkeessaa dha jechuun himatteetti.

title: Rain brings temporary relief as Southeast Asia battles fires and toxic haze
english: Recent rainfall has provided a short break from the wildfires currently affecting Indonesia. Despite this, persistent underground peat fires are still active, causing dangerous levels of air pollution across Southeast Asia. The resulting toxic haze has forced schools to shut down and triggered widespread health issues among the local population.

title: The WhatsApp ‘general’ behind Lula’s election comeback in Brazil
english: Brazilian Congressman Andre Janones is credited with helping President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva secure his recent election victory by organizing a massive digital movement. Janones utilized a WhatsApp channel called 'Lula's Army' to mobilize supporters, growing the group to nearly 11 million subscribers during the final weeks of the campaign. By adopting aggressive social media tactics, he successfully countered the opposition's online influence and boosted morale for Lula's campaign when it was struggling.
amharic: የብራዚል የፓርላማ አባል አንድሬ ጃኖነስ ለፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ የምርጫ ድል ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ አድርገዋል። ጃኖነስ 'የሉላ ጦር' የተሰኘ የዋትስአፕ ግሩፕ በመፍጠር በምርጫው የመጨረሻ ሳምንታት ወደ 11 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ተከታዮችን በማሰባሰብ የሉላን ዘመቻ አጠናክረዋል። ተቀናቃኞቻቸውን ለመግጠም በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የተጠቀሙባቸው ስልቶች የሉላ ዘመቻ ፈታኝ በሆነበት ወቅት ድጋፋቸውን በማሳደግ ወሳኝ ሚና ተጫውተዋል።
oromo: miseensi mana maree biyya Brazil Andre Janones, injifannoo filannoo pirezidaant Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva irratti gahee guddaa taphateera. Janones 'Waraana Lula' kan jedhamuun garaa 'WhatsApp' fayyadamuun, torbanneen dhumaa duula filannoo keessatti namoota miliyoona 11 ol ofitti qabuun deeggarsa Lula cimseera. Mala midiyaa hawaasaa irratti fayyadame kanaan, duulli Lula rakkoo keessa ture akka deebi'ee cimuuf gargaareera.

title: Oman calls for Gulf, Iraq and Iran to unite under one security pact
english: Omani Foreign Minister Badr al-Busaidi has proposed a new non-aggression security pact involving Gulf states, Iraq, and Iran to promote regional independence. He argued that the region must stop relying on external powers like the US and instead create a unified framework that includes Iran. According to Busaidi, viewing Iran as a permanent enemy is a harmful misconception that undermines long-term stability and regional cooperation.
amharic: የኦማን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ባድር አል-ቡሳይዲ የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት፣ ኢራቅ እና ኢራን ክልላዊ ደህንነታቸውን በራሳቸው እንዲቆጣጠሩ የሚያስችል አዲስ የጋራ ስምምነት እንዲፈጥሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ሚኒስትሩ አገራቱ ከውጭ ኃይሎች ጥገኝነት በመውጣት፣ ኢራንን ያካተተ የተረጋጋ የደህንነት ማዕቀፍ መዘርጋት እንዳለባቸው አስረድተዋል። ኢራንን እንደ ጠላት መመልከት ለክልሉ መረጋጋት ጎጂ የሆነ የተሳሳተ አመለካከት መሆኑንም ገልጸዋል።

Mootummoonni kunneen hirkattummaa humnoota alaa irraa bilisa bahuun, Iraanis kan keessatti argamtu mootummaa nageenyaa waliinii diriirsuu akka qaban ibsaniiru. Busaidi akka jedhanitti, Iraan diina dhaabbataa godhanii fudhachuun yaada dogoggoraa kan biyyoota sanaaf miidhaa qabu dha.

title: Smotrich says ‘Arab turnout unprecedented’
english: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has called on right-wing supporters to vote, warning that high participation among Arab citizens could lead to a left-wing government. He urged his base to remain hopeful about their chances of winning despite the current electoral trends. Palestinian politicians have criticized these remarks, labeling them as incitement against the Arab minority population.
amharic: የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር በጻሌል ስሞትሪች፣ በአረብ ተወላጅ እስራኤላውያን በኩል እየታየ ያለው ከፍተኛ የምርጫ ተሳትፎ የግራ ዘመም መንግስትን ስልጣን ላይ ሊያወጣ ይችላል በሚል የቀኝ ዘመም ደጋፊዎቻቸውን ድምጽ እንዲሰጡ አሳስበዋል። በምርጫው ማሸነፍ እንደሚቻል ለደጋፊዎቻቸው የገለጹት ሚኒስትሩ፣ ይህ ንግግራቸው በሀገሪቱ አረብ ተወላጆች ላይ የሚደረግ ቅስቀሳ ነው በሚል ከፍ ያለ ትችት ገጥሞታል። የአረብ ተወላጆች የእስራኤልን ህዝብ 20 በመቶ ይሸፍናሉ።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Israa'el Bezalel Smotrich, lammiileen Israa'el kanneen Arabummaa qaban sagalee kennuuf gara saanduqa filannoo ba'uun isaanii mootummaa gara bitaatti madaatu gara aangootti fiduu danda'a jechuun deggertoota isaanii qilleensatti waameera. Ministirichi deggertoota isaa filannoo kanatti injifachuu akka danda'an yaadachiiseera. Haata'u malee, siyaasaonni Arabootaa gochi kun lammiilee Israa'el kanneen biyyattii keessa jiraatan irratti kaayyoo gaarii hin qabneefi doorsisa jechuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Ra’am says Israeli police seized ballot boxes in Negev
english: The Ra’am party has reported that Israeli police confiscated ballot boxes in the Negev town of Arara. Authorities have also halted the voting process in that specific electoral district. This action has effectively disrupted the local election activities.
amharic: የራአም ፓርቲ የኢትዮጵያ ፖሊስ በኔጌቭ በምትገኘው አራራ ከተማ የምርጫ ሳጥኖችን መውሰዱን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም የጸጥታ ሃይሎች በዚያ አካባቢ የሚካሄደውን የምርጫ ሂደት እንዲቆም ማድረጋቸው ተነግሯል። ይህ ድርጊት በአካባቢው የሚካሄደውን የምርጫ ሂደት ሙሉ ለሙሉ አቋርጦታል።
oromo: Paartiin Ra’am akka gabaasetti, poolisiin Israa’el magaalaa Araraa, kan Naagev keessatti argamtu keessatti sanduuqota sagalee fudhataniiru. Kana malees, qaamoleen nageenyaa naannoo sanaatti adeemsi filannoo akka dhaabbatu godhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun adeemsa filannoo naannichaa guutummaatti addaan kutee jira.

title: Ra’am’s Abbas calls for sustained voting to ‘bring down’ Netanyahu
english: Mansour Abbas, leader of the Ra'am party, has urged citizens to vote in the upcoming election to help remove Benjamin Netanyahu and his right-wing allies from power. He accused Netanyahu of using his party as a political distraction to energize right-wing voters. Abbas emphasized that strong voter turnout is the key to defeating the current government leadership.
amharic: የራአም ፓርቲ መሪ ማንሱር አባስ፣ ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ እና አጋሮቻቸውን ከስልጣን ለማስወገድ በአዲሱ ምርጫ ላይ በስፋት እንዲሳተፉ እና ድምፅ እንዲሰጡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ኔታንያሁ የራአም ፓርቲን የቀኝ ዘመም ደጋፊዎቹን ለማነሳሳት እንደ መጠቀሚያ እየተጠቀሙበት እንደሆነም ተችተዋል። አባስ፣ የምርጫውን ውጤት በመቀየር የአሁኑን መንግስት ለመጣል ብቸኛው መንገድ ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ድምፅ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii Ra'am, Mansuur Abbaas, filannoo dhufu irratti sagalee kennuun mootummaa Binyamin Netanyaahuu fi deggertoota isaa aangoo irraa kaasuun akka danda'amu ibsaniiru. Netanyaahuun paartii isaanii kun namoota kaayyoo isaanii deggaran kakaasuuf akka malaatti itti fayyadamaa akka jiru himatanii jiru. Abbaas, mootummaa ammaa kana injifachuuf sagaleen uummataa murteessaa ta'uu isaa hubachiisaniiru.

title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
english: The leaders of Finland and Norway recently conducted an unusual phone conversation with Vladimir Putin to discuss potential ways to end the ongoing war in Ukraine. While the initiative was independent and not representative of all European nations, the leaders emphasized the urgent need for diplomatic progress to restore regional stability. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky was briefed on the discussion, as the parties prepare for upcoming trilateral negotiations aimed at finding a peaceful resolution.
amharic: የፊንላንድ እና የኖርዌይ መሪዎች በዩክሬን ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም በሚቻልባቸው መንገዶች ዙሪያ ከቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር ያልተለመደ የስልክ ውይይት አድርገዋል። ይህ ተነሳሽነት የአውሮፓ አገራትን በሙሉ የሚወክል ባይሆንም፣ መሪዎቹ የክልሉን ሰላም ለመመለስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረት ማድረግ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ ስለ ውይይቱ መረጃ የተሰጣቸው ሲሆን፣ ሁለቱ ወገኖች ወደፊት ሊደረግ የታቀደው የሶስትዮሽ የሰላም ድርድር አካል በመሆን እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni biyyoota Finland fi Norway waraana Yukreen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru dhaabuuf karaa itti danda'amu irratti pirezidaantii Raashiyaa Vladimir Putin waliin bilbilan mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun biyyoota Awurooppaa hundaa kan bakka bu'u baatus, hoggantoonni kunneen nagaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa deebisuuf mariin diippiloomaasii barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodymyr Zelensky marii kana ilaalchisee odeeffannoo kan argatan yoo ta'u, gama isaaniitiin marii sadan-kallattii fuulduratti gaggeeffamuuf qophaa'aa jiru.

title: Kylian Mbappe apologises after ‘dictator’ comment angers Chinese fans

title: Ebola cases in DR Congo surpass 10,000 in fastest-growing outbreak
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing its most severe Ebola outbreak on record, with confirmed cases now exceeding 10,000 and nearly 5,000 deaths. This specific strain, known as Bundibugyo, lacks an approved vaccine or treatment, though initial clinical trials have recently begun. Health authorities are struggling to contain the disease as it spreads into new regions, with many patients failing to receive necessary medical care.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ በታሪኳ እጅግ አስከፊ የሆነውን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ እያስተናገደች ሲሆን፣ የተያዙት ሰዎች ቁጥር ከ10,000 በላይ ሆኗል፤ ከዚህ ውስጥም ወደ 5,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በቡንዲቡግዮ ቫይረስ አማካኝነት የተከሰተው ይህ ወረርሽኝ እስካሁን ህክምና ወይም ክትባት ያልተገኘለት ሲሆን፣ የመጀመሪያዎቹ የክሊኒካል ምርመራዎች በቅርቡ ተጀምረዋል። ወረርሽኙ ወደ አዳዲስ አካባቢዎች እየተስፋፋ በመሆኑ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ህሙማንን በመቆጣጠር ረገድ ከፍተኛ ችግር እየገጠማቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebola hanga ammaatti namoota 10,000 ol irratti kan argame yoo ta'u, namoonni 5,000 ol du'aniiru. Vaayirasiin kun kan addaa ta'e 'Bundibugyo' jedhamu waan ta'eef, hanga ammaatti qorichi ykn talaalliin sirnaan itti hojjetamu hin jiru, garuu qorannoon jalqabaa eegaleera. Dhibee kana to'achuun ulfaataa ta'ee kan jiru yoo ta'u, sababa babal'ina isaa irraan kan ka'e namoonni hedduun gargaarsa fayyaa barbaachisaa ta'e argachuu hin dandeenye.

title: The Ballon d’Or has a narrow definition of footballing greatness
english: The Ballon d’Or is widely regarded as football’s most prestigious individual award, recently won by Harry Kane. However, critics argue the prize is limited by a heavy bias toward attacking players and European leagues. Furthermore, the increasing commercialization of the sport and the branding of individual stars have raised concerns about whether the award accurately reflects true footballing excellence.
amharic: ባሎንዶር በዓለም እግርኳስ እጅግ የተከበረ የግል ሽልማት ተደርጎ ቢወሰድም፣ በቅርቡ ሃሪ ኬን አሸናፊ ሆኗል። ይሁን እንጂ ተቺዎች ሽልማቱ በአጥቂ ተጫዋቾች እና በአውሮፓ ሊጎች ላይ ብቻ ያደላ በመሆኑ ገደብ እንዳለበት ይከራከራሉ። ከዚህም በላይ የእግርኳስ ጨዋታ ወደ ንግድ ስራ መለወጡ እና ተጫዋቾች እንደ ምርት ስም መታየታቸው ሽልማቱ የእግርኳስን እውነተኛ ብቃት በትክክል የሚመዘን መሆኑን ጥያቄ ውስጥ ጥሎታል።
oromo: Badhaasni Ballon d'Or kabaja guddaa qabu ta'us, dhiheenya kana Harry Kane isa mo'ateera. Ta'us, qaamoleen goggodaan badhaasichi gita dorgommiin ala ta'eefi biyyoota Awurooppaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu isaa ni mormu. Dabalataanis, kubbaan miillaa gara daldalaatti jijjiiramuufi taphattoota akka 'brand'itti ilaaluun, badhaasichi gahumsa dhugaa taphattootaa sirritti kan calaqqisu ta'uu isaa shakkii keessa galcheera.

title: Former PLO official says Netanyahu-Eisenkot coalition could be possible
english: A former PLO official, Xavier Abu Eid, believes that Israel's upcoming election results are currently unpredictable. He suggests that political rivals Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot might eventually put aside their disagreements to establish a national unity government. This possibility remains a subject of discussion as the country waits to see the final electoral outcome.
amharic: የቀድሞው የፍልስጤም ነፃ አውጪ ድርጅት (PLO) ባለስልጣን የሆኑት ሀቪየር አቡ ኢድ፣ በእስራኤል እየተካሄደ ያለው ምርጫ ውጤት እርግጠኛ አለመሆኑን ገልጸዋል። እንደ እርሳቸው ገለጻ፣ የፖለቲካ ተቀናቃኞቹ ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ እና ጋዲ አይዘንኮት ልዩነቶቻቸውን በመተው ጥምር መንግስት የመመስረት እድል አላቸው። ይህ ሁኔታ የምርጫውን የመጨረሻ ውጤት በመጠባበቅ ላይ ባሉ ወገኖች ዘንድ እየተነጋገረበት ይገኛል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni duraanii jaarmiyaa bilisummaa Phalastiin (PLO) Xavier Abu Eid akka jedhanitti, bu’aan filannoo Israa’el hamma ammaatti mirkanaa’aa miti. Ibsa isaaniitiin, morkattoonni siyaasaa Benjamin Netanyahu fi Gadi Eisenkot garaagarummaa isaanii cinaatti dhiisanii mootummaa tokkummaa biyyaalessaa hundeessuuf carraa qabu. Haalli kun bu’aan dhumaa filannichaa maal akka fakkaatu eeggachaa kan jiru ta’uusaa ibsameera.

title: Voter turnout highest since 1973 as of 2pm
english: Israel is experiencing its most active election day in decades, with voter participation reaching levels not seen since 1973. By 2 p.m. local time, nearly 45 percent of all eligible citizens had already submitted their votes. Election officials confirmed this record-breaking turnout, indicating a very high level of civic engagement.
amharic: እስራኤል ከ1973 ወዲህ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ሁኔታ ከፍተኛ የምርጫ ተሳትፎ እያሳየች ነው። ከቀኑ 8 ሰዓት እስካሁን ባለው መረጃ መሰረት 44.9 በመቶ የሚሆኑ መራጮች ድምጻቸውን ሰጥተዋል። የምርጫ ኮሚቴው እንደገለጸው ይህ በበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ውስጥ የተመዘገበ ከፍተኛው የመራጮች ቁጥር ነው።
oromo: Israa'el keessatti guyyaan filannoo kun waggoota dheeraa booda hirmaannaa uummataa olaanaa qabaachaa jira. Sa'aatii 8:00tti, namoonni mirga sagalee kennuu qaban keessaa dhibbeentaa 44.9 sagalee isaanii kennaniiru. Kunis, biyyattii keessatti hirmaannaan filannoo waggaa 1973 asitti kan hunda caalu ta'uun mirkanaa'eera.

title: 'Detained and interrogated': Israel blocks British MPs from entering occupied West Bank to meet Palestinians
english: Israeli authorities recently prevented a 23-member international delegation, including British politicians, from entering the occupied West Bank. The group was detained and interrogated for several hours at the border while attempting to attend a conference and support Palestinian farmers during the olive harvest. Despite their efforts to show solidarity with communities facing military violence, the delegates were eventually denied entry without a clear explanation.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት የእንግሊዝ ፓርላማ አባላትን ጨምሮ 23 አባላት ያሉት ዓለም አቀፍ ልዑክ ወደ ተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ እንዳይገቡ ከልክለዋል። ቡድኑ በጉባኤ ለመሳተፍ እና የወይራ ምርት በሚሰበስቡበት ወቅት ፍልስጤማውያን አርሶ አደሮችን ለመደገፍ ሲሞክር ድንበር ላይ ለሰዓታት ታስሮ ተጠይቋል። ልዑካኑ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እየደረሰባቸው ያሉትን ማህበረሰቦች ለመደገፍ ቢሞክሩም፣ እስራኤል ያለምንም በቂ ምክንያት ወደ ክልሉ እንዳይገቡ አግዳቸዋለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el miseensota mana maree biyyoota Ingilizii dabalatee, gareen idil-addunyaa 23 of keessaa qabu gara lafa Qillee (West Bank) akka hin galle dhorkeera. Gareen kun walga'ii irratti hirmaachuufi yeroo raafuu (zeytunaa) sassaabanitti qonnaan bultoota Falastiin gargaaruuf yeroo yaalanitti, daangaa irratti sa'aatii dheeraaf qabamanii gaaffii fi deebii godhaniiru. Miseensonni kunneen hawaasa miidhaan waraanaa irra ga'aa jiru cinaa dhaabbachuuf yaalanis, Israa'el sababa ga'aa tokko malee akka seenan hayyamuufii diddeetti.

title: Monitor warns of delays at polling stations in Palestinian communities in Israel
english: A rights organization reported significant voting delays and long queues at polling stations within Palestinian communities in Israel. Monitors noted that police interference, unnecessary questioning by election staff, and occasional closures hindered the voting process. Consequently, the group has filed a formal complaint with the national election committee to address these issues.
amharic: አንድ የመብት ተሟጋች ድርጅት በእስራኤል በሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ማህበረሰቦች ውስጥ በምርጫ ጣቢያዎች ከፍተኛ የሆነ መዘግየት እና ረጅም ሰልፎች መኖራቸውን አስታውቋል። የፖሊስ ጣልቃገብነት፣ የምርጫ አስፈፃሚዎች አግባብ ያልሆነ ጥያቄ ማቅረብ እና አንዳንድ ጣቢያዎች በጊዜያዊነት መዘጋታቸው የምርጫ ሂደቱን እንዳስተጓጎሉ ታዛቢዎች ገልጸዋል። በዚሁ መሰረት ድርጅቱ ችግሩን ለሀገሪቱ የምርጫ ኮሚቴ በይፋ አቤቱታ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa tokko, guutuu Israa'el keessatti bakkeewwan filannoo kanneen hawaasa Filisxeemii irratti hiriirri dheeraan fi harkifannaan guddaan mudachuu isaa beeksiseera. Hojjettoota filannoo fi poolisiin dhimmi isaan hin ilaallanne irratti gaaffii gaafachuu fi bakkeewwan filannoo tokko tokko cufamuu isaaniitiin adeemsi filannoo sun gufachuun isaa ibsameera. Haaluma kanaan, dhaabbatichi rakkoo kana ilaalchisee komii isaa koree filannoo biyyattii tiif dhiheeffateera.

title: Israeli forces kill 14 in Gaza as UN commission says genocide continues
english: Israeli military operations across Gaza have resulted in the deaths of 14 Palestinians over the past two days, including a young child. A recent UN commission report asserts that Israel is still carrying out genocidal acts, war crimes, and sexual violence despite an existing ceasefire agreement. The commission further warned that these systematic attacks are causing widespread destruction and civilian harm in both Gaza and the occupied West Bank.
amharic: ባለፉት ሁለት ቀናት በእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተወሰደ እርምጃ በጋዛ 14 ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸውን የፍልስጤም የጤና ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ኮሚሽን እስራኤል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን በመጣስ በጋዛ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል፣ የጦር ወንጀል እና የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን እየፈጸመች መሆኗን በሪፖርቱ አረጋግጧል። ይህ ጥቃት በጋዛም ሆነ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ በሲቪል ህዝቡ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ መሆኑን ተገልጿል።
oromo: Guyyoota lamaan darban keessatti waraanni Israa'el gaazaa keessatti duula gaggeessiteen namoonni Falasxiin 14 ta'an ajjeefamaniiru. Komishiniin tokkummaa mootummootaa gabaasa baaseen, Israa'el walii galtee waraana dhaabuu diigdee, yakka sanyiin balleessuu fi yakka waraanaa raawwachuu ishee ibseera. Miidhaan kun qaama guutuu Falasxiin irratti kan raawwatamaa jiruufi namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa akka jiru komishinichi akeekkachiiseera.

title: Mike Huckabee criticised for distinguishing between Israelis and 'Arabs' in elections
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has drawn backlash for a social media post that seemingly differentiated between Israeli citizens and Arab citizens during Israel's election day. Critics highlighted that Palestinian citizens of Israel have the legal right to vote, making the ambassador's phrasing misleading and exclusionary. Many online users pointed out that Arab residents who vote are indeed Israeli citizens, contradicting the distinction made in his remarks.
amharic: የአሜሪካው አምባሳደር ማይክ ሃካቢ በእስራኤል ምርጫ ቀን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ባሰፈሩት ጽሑፍ እስራኤላውያንን እና አረቦችን ለያይተው በመጥቀሳቸው ትችት ገጥሟቸዋል። ተቺዎች እንደገለጹት በእስራኤል የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ዜጎች የመምረጥ መብት ስላላቸው የአምባሳደሩ አገላለጽ የተሳሳተ እና አድልዎ የተሞላበት ነው። በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የተሰጡ አስተያየቶች እንደሚያሳዩት ድምጽ የሚሰጡት አረቦች የእስራኤል ዜግነት ያላቸው መሆናቸውን በመጠቆም የአምባሳደሩን ንግግር ተቃውመዋል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa gara Israaʼelitti ergaman Maayik Haakabii, guyyaa filannoo Israaʼelirratti ergaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti barreessaniin lammiilee Israaʼelii fi Araboota gargar baasuun isaanii mormii guddaa kaaseera. Namoonni hedduu, lammiileen Falasxiin kan Israaʼel keessa jiraatan mirga sagalee kennuu akka qaban beeksisuun, dubbiin ambaasaaddarichaa dogoggoraa fi qoodinsa kan uumu taʼuu ibsaniiru. Namoonni hedduun, namoonni sagalee kennan hundinuu lammiilee Israaʼel taʼuu isaanii ibsuun, yaada ambaasaaddarichaa mormaniiru.

title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
english: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's recent election victory in Brazil has complicated Donald Trump's political influence in Latin America. Throughout his campaign, Lula took a firm stance against perceived US interference, prioritizing Brazilian sovereignty and successfully challenging his opponents' claims of patriotism. Although Trump previously maintained strong ties with former leader Jair Bolsonaro, Lula's direct and defiant approach forced the US to navigate a more complex diplomatic relationship with Brazil.
amharic: የሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ የቅርብ ጊዜ የምርጫ ድል በላቲን አሜሪካ ላይ የነበረውን የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ፈታኝ አድርጎታል። በዘመቻው ወቅት ሉላ በአሜሪካ ጣልቃገብነት ላይ ጠንካራ አቋም በመውሰድ የብራዚልን ሉዓላዊነት ቀዳሚ አድርገው ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ትራምፕ ከቀድሞው መሪ ጃኢር ቦልሶናሮ ጋር የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ቢኖራቸውም፣ የሉላ ደፋር አቀራረብ አሜሪካ ከብራዚል ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት እንደገና እንድትገመግም አስገድዷታል።
oromo: Injifannoon filannoo Luu'iz Inaasiyoo Luulaa da Siilvaa kan biyya Braazil dhiibbaa siyaasaa Doonaald Tiraamp kan Laatiin Ameerikaa keessatti qaban ulfaataa taasiseera. Duula filannoo isaanii keessatti, Luulaan dhiibbaa Ameerikaan biyyattii irratti gootu mormuudhaan aangoo fi bilisummaa biyya isaanii kabachiisuuf cimanii falmaniiru. Tiraamp kanaan dura hogganaa duraanii Ja'iir Bolsoonaaroo wajjin walitti dhufeenya cimaa kan qaban ta'us, tarkaanfiin cimaan Luulaa fudhatanii fi ejjannoon isaanii Ameerikaan hariiroo ishee kan Braazil wajjin qabdu akka haaromsuuf dirqisiiseera.

title: Truce begins in wartorn Ukraine city after it was announced by Melania Trump
english: A ceasefire has officially started in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky following an agreement facilitated by US First Lady Melania Trump. This pause in fighting aims to provide life-saving humanitarian aid and evacuate civilians who have been suffering from severe shortages of essential supplies. Both Russian and Ukrainian officials have confirmed they are honoring the truce to allow for the safe delivery of support to the remaining residents.
amharic: በሩሲያ ቁጥጥር ስር በምትገኘው የዩክሬን ከተማ ኦሌሽኪ በአሜሪካ ቀዳማዊት እመቤት ሜላኒያ ትራምፕ አማካኝነት የተደራደረ የጦርነት ማቆም ስምምነት ተግባራዊ ሆኗል። ይህ የእርምጃ እገዳ ለሲቪሎች አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የሰብአዊ እርዳታዎችን ለማድረስ እና በከባድ የቁሳቁስ እጥረት ለሚሰቃዩ ነዋሪዎች መውጫ መንገድ ለመክፈት ያለመ ነው። የሩሲያ እና የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት ስምምነቱን በማክበር በከተማዋ ሰላማዊ እንቅስቃሴ እንዲኖር እየተባበሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa Yukreen kan Raashiyaan qabamte Ooleshkii keessatti, mormii waraanaa dhaabuun kan jalqabe yoo ta'u, kunis akkaataa waliigaltee haadha warraa pireezidaantii Ameerikaa Melaaniyaa Tiraampitiin dhiyaateen ta'e. Dhaabbiin waraanaa kun gargaarsa namoomaa fi namoota nagaa rakkoo nyaataa fi qulqullinaa keessa jiran baasuuf barbaachiseera. Mootummoonni Raashiyaa fi Yukreenis dhaabbii waraanaa kana kabajuun deeggarsa namoomaa hatattamaa ta'e akka ga'uuf waliigaleeru.

title: Opposition leader María Machado returns from exile to a Venezuela reshaped by Trump
english: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado has returned home from exile to a significantly altered political landscape. Following the US-led removal of Nicolás Maduro from power, the country is now under the leadership of Delcy Rodríguez, who has established a cooperative relationship with Washington. While supporters view Machado's return as a symbol of hope for the electoral process, she now faces the challenge of navigating a government that the current US administration appears willing to work with.
amharic: የቬኔዝዌላ የተቃዋሚ መሪ ማሪያ ኮሪና ማቻዶ ከስደት ወደ ሀገራቸው ተመልሰዋል። የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ በአሜሪካ ጣልቃ ገብነት ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ በኋላ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት ሀገሪቱን የሚመሩት ዴልሲ ሮድሪጌዝ ከአሜሪካ ጋር የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ፈጥረዋል። ደጋፊዎቿ የተመለሱበትን ሁኔታ እንደ ተስፋ ምልክት ቢመለከቱትም፣ ማቻዶ አሁን አዲስ የሆነውን እና ከአሜሪካ ጋር በስምምነት የሚሰራ መንግስትን መጋፈጥ ይጠበቅባቸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantuun mormituu Venezuweela Mariiyaa Korinaa Maachaadoon baqannaa booda gara biyyaatti deebi'aniiru. Pirezidaantiin kanaan duraa Niikolaas Maaduuroon humna Ameerikaatiin aangoo irraa erga buufamanii booda, amma biyyattiin kan bulchaa jirtu Delesii Rodriigeeziin yoo ta'u, isheenis mootummaa Ameerikaa waliin hariiroo gaarii uummattetti. Deeggartoonni isaanii deebi'uu isanii akka mallattoo abdii tokkootti fudhatanis, Maachaadoon amma mootummaa haaraa fi Ameerikaa waliin hojjechaa jiru kana waliin mormii isaanii itti fufuu fi qormaata isaa keessa darbuu qabu.

title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
english: Jordanian fighter jets launched an airstrike on a village in southern Syria, claiming to target terrorist groups responsible for a deadly funeral shooting in Karak. Syrian authorities reported that five civilians, including women and children, were killed in the attack and subsequently closed the only commercial border crossing between the two countries. While Jordan insists it coordinated the strike, Syria denies prior notification and has launched an investigation into the incident.
amharic: የዮርዳኖስ አየር ኃይል በካራክ ቤተክርስቲያን የቀብር ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ ጥቃት ያደረሱ አሸባሪዎችን ኢላማ ያደረገ የአየር ድብደባ በደቡባዊ ሶሪያ ፈጽሟል። የሶሪያ ባለሥልጣናት ድብደባው ሴቶችና ሕፃናትን ጨምሮ አምስት ንፁሃን ዜጎችን እንደገደለ በመግለጽ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ዋና የንግድ መተላለፊያ በጊዜያዊነት ዘግተዋል። ዮርዳኖስ ጥቃቱን ከሶሪያ መንግሥት ጋር አስተባብራ እንደፈፀመች ብትናገርም፣ የሶሪያ መንግሥት ግን አስቀድሞ ማሳወቂያ እንዳልደረሰው በመግለጽ በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Humnoonni qilleensaa Yordaanos, haleellaa awwaalcha waldaa Kiristaanaa magaalaa Kaaraakitti raawwatamee ture hordofee, garee shororkeessitoota jedhaman irratti Soriyaa keessatti haleellaa qilleensaa raawwataniiru. Aangeyyoonni Soriyaa haleellaa kanaan dubartootaa fi daa'imman dabalatee namoonni shan ajjeefamuu fi daandiin daldalaa Yordaanosii fi Soriyaa wal quunnamsiisu cufamuu beeksisaniiru. Yordaanos haleellichi mootummaa Soriyaa waliin mari'atamee raawwatame jedhus, Soriyaan dursanii akka hin beekne ibsuun qorannoo eegaltee jirti.

title: Ex-FBI chief James Comey faces federal charges for third time
english: Former FBI Director James Comey is facing federal charges for the third time, accused of leaking classified national defense information to the media in 2016. Comey has strongly denied these allegations, describing the prosecution as an unjust abuse of power and maintaining his innocence. His legal team is seeking to dismiss the case, arguing that the charges lack merit and may be barred by the statute of limitations.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኤፍቢአይ (FBI) ዳይሬክተር ጄምስ ኮሚ በ2016 ለፕሬስ ሚስጥራዊ የመከላከያ መረጃዎችን አሳልፈው ሰጥተዋል በሚል ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ በፌዴራል ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል። ኮሚ ክሱን በጥብቅ በመቃወም ድርጊቱን ፍትሕን አላግባብ መጠቀም ሲሉ በመግለጽ ንጹሕ መሆናቸውን አስረግጠው ተናግረዋል። የሕግ ባለሙያዎቻቸው ክሱ ተገቢ አለመሆኑን እና በጊዜ ገደብ ምክንያት መቋረጥ እንዳለበት በመከራከር ክሱ እንዲሰረዝ ጥያቄ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Darektarri duraanii FBI Jeems Komiin, bara 2016 odeeffannoo icitii biyyaa miidiyaaleef dabarsaniiru jedhamanii yeroo sadaffaaf himata federaalaa irratti banameera. Komiin himata kana cimsuun kan morman yoo ta'u, gochi kun aangoo seeraan ala fayyadamuu akka ta'eefi ofi isaanii qulqulluu akka ta'an ibsaniiru. Gareen abbootii seeraa isaanii himatichi kan hin malle ta'uu fi yeroon seeraa darbuu isaa eeruun, himata kana akka haqamu gaafataniiru.

title: Wales first minister : ‘We’re within a union that is not a union of equals’
english: The First Minister of Wales, Rhun ap Iorwerth, is calling for a new agreement with the United Kingdom, arguing that the current political union is fundamentally unequal. He has formally requested that the British government transfer authority over key areas like policing, justice, and natural resources to the Welsh government. While he is leading a movement toward potential independence, he clarified that he does not intend to hold a referendum during the current parliamentary term.
amharic: የዌልስ ቀዳሚ ሚኒስትር ሩን አፕ አይርወርዝ፣ አሁን ያለው የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የፖለቲካ ህብረት እኩልነት የጎደለው በመሆኑ አዲስ ስምምነት እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልጸዋል። ከብሪታንያ መንግስት የፖሊስ፣ የፍትህ እና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት አስተዳደርን የመሳሰሉ ቁልፍ ስልጣኖችን ወደ ዌልስ እንዲዘዋወሩ በይፋ ጠይቀዋል። የዌልስን ነጻነት የሚደግፈው ፓርቲ መሪ ቢሆኑም፣ በአሁኑ የፓርላማ ዘመን የነጻነት ህዝበ ውሳኔ ለማድረግ እንደማይፈልጉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri duraanii kan Weels, Ruun ap Iorweerth, walitti dhufeenyi siyaasaa biyyoota Gamtaa Mootummaa (UK) jidduu jiru wal-qixxee miti jedhee waan amanuuf, waliigaltee haaraa akka barbaadu gaafate. Mootummaan Britaaniyaa aangoo qabiinsa poolisii, sirna haqaa fi qabeenya uumamaa to'achuu akka Weelsitti dabarsu beeksisera. Inni gara bilisummaatti deemuuf tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiruus, yeroo ammaatti mana maree kana keessatti sagalee kenniisaa (referendum) bilisummaa gaggeessuuf karoorri akka hin jirre ibsera.

title: South Korea’s GDP growth beats forecasts amid AI boom
english: South Korea's economy grew by 3.4 percent over the past year, significantly outperforming initial expectations. This economic surge was largely driven by a massive increase in demand for semiconductors and technology used for artificial intelligence. While domestic spending slightly decreased, strong export figures position the country for its best annual growth rate in over a decade.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ ኢኮኖሚ ባለፈው አንድ ዓመት ውስጥ በ3.4 በመቶ በማደግ ከጠበቁት በላይ የተሻለ ውጤት አስመዝግቧል። ይህ ፈጣን እድገት በዋናነት ለሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የሚያገለግሉ ቺፖች እና የቴክኖሎጂ ውጤቶች ፍላጎት መጨመር ጋር የተያያዘ ነው። የአገር ውስጥ ፍጆታ ትንሽ መቀነስ ቢታይም፣ የኤክስፖርት ንግድ ጥንካሬ አገሪቱ ከስድስት ዓመታት በላይ ባልታየ መልኩ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ እድገት ለማስመዝገብ እየተንቀሳቀሰች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Diinagdeen Kooriyaa Kibbaa waggaa darbe keessa garaagartee eegametti aansuun dhibbeentaa 3.4 guddateera. Guddinni kun kan dhufuuf dandeettiifi teeknoolojii 'artificial intelligence' (AI) irratti fedhiin guddaan jiraachuun isaa sababii guddaa dha. Foddaan keessa biyyaa xiqqoo hir'atus, gurgurtaan alaa (export) ciminaan itti fufee waan jiruuf, biyyattiin waggaa kudhanii oliif guddataa kan hin turre guddaa diinagdee cimaa galmeessuuf deemti.

title: Sixty Christians killed in Ethiopia’s Oromia region
english: At least 60 Orthodox Christians were killed and many others injured in a series of violent attacks across Ethiopia's Oromia region in late October. Church officials have condemned these events, which also resulted in the destruction of numerous homes, and are calling on the government to ensure security and justice. While local authorities have blamed a rebel alliance for the violence, the situation remains tense as the region continues to struggle with ongoing insecurity.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ኦሮሚያ ክልል በተፈጸመ ተከታታይ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 60 የኦርቶዶክስ ክርስቲያኖች መገደላቸውንና ብዙዎች መቁሰላቸውን የቤተክርስቲያን ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል። የቤተክርስቲያኗ ቅዱስ ሲኖዶስ ጥቃቱን በማውገዝ መንግስት የዜጎችን ደህንነት እንዲጠብቅና ለተፈጠረው ግፍ ተጠያቂዎችን ለህግ እንዲያቀርብ ጥሪ አቅርቧል። ጥቃቱ በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ያወደመ ሲሆን በክልሉ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ሳቢያ እየተባባሰ የመጣ የጸጥታ ችግር አካል እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Naannoo Oromiyaatti garee amantoota Ortodoksii 60 ol ta'anirratti haleellaa suukanneessaa raawwatameeni lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Haleellaa kana keessatti namoonni hedduun miidhamaanii manneen jireenyaas gubataniiru; Waldaan Ortodoksii Itiyoophiyaas gocha kana cimaadhaan balaaleffateera. Mootummaan ittigaafatamtoota seeraatti dhiyeessuudhaan nageenya uummataaf xiyyeeffannoo kennuu akka qabu dhaabbanni amantichaa gaafateera.

title: Palestine weekly: West Bank under siege as Israelis go to the polls
english: As Israelis participate in national elections, the West Bank city of Hebron is under a strict military lockdown following a deadly attack on soldiers. Israeli forces have forced thousands of Palestinians to flee their homes while conducting widespread raids, house searches, and building demolitions. The region remains heavily restricted by numerous checkpoints and closures as officials declare the displacement will continue until security objectives are met.
amharic: እስራኤላውያን በምርጫ ሂደት ላይ ባሉበት ወቅት፣ በሄብሮን ከተማ በተፈጠረ የጥቃት ክስተት ሳቢያ ዌስት ባንክ በወታደራዊ ከበባ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በመኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ወረራ በማካሄድና ሕንፃዎችን በማፍረስ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያንን ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አስገድደዋል። የደህንነት ግቦቻቸው እስኪሳኩ ድረስ በከተማዋ ላይ የተጣለው የጉዞ ገደብ እና የቤት ለቤት ፍተሻ እንደሚቀጥል ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Israa'eloonni filannoo gaggeessaa osoo jiranuu, magaalaan Heebroon haleellaa waraana irratti raawwatameen walqabatee harka waraanaatiin marfamtee jirti. Loltoonni Israa'el manneen jireenyaa keessa seenuudhaan uummata kumaatamaan lakkaawwamu qe'ee isaanii irraa ari'anii fi mana hedduu diiganii jiru. Mootummaan Israa'el tarkaanfiin kun hanga kaayyoon nageenyaa guutuutti akka itti fufu ibsee jira.

title: Morning update
english: The US Embassy in Riyadh has advised non-essential staff and their families to depart Saudi Arabia due to ongoing security concerns following Houthi missile and drone attacks. Meanwhile, Israel is currently holding its first general election since October 2023, with over seven million citizens eligible to vote. Additionally, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has dismissed rumors about plans to dismiss the military chief of staff, while Donald Trump has blamed Iran for escalating regional conflicts.
amharic: በሪያድ የሚገኘው የአሜሪካ ኤምባሲ በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ በሚገኙ የሁቲዎች የሮኬት እና ድሮን ጥቃቶች ምክንያት፣ አስፈላጊ ያልሆኑ ሰራተኞች እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው ሀገሪቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አሳስቧል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ከጥቅምት 2023 ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ እስራኤል ጠቅላላ ምርጫዋን እያካሄደች ሲሆን ከሰባት ሚሊዮን በላይ ዜጎች ድምጽ እየሰጡ ይገኛሉ። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁም የጦር አዛዡን የማሰናበት ወሬ መሰረት የለሽ መሆኑን ያስተባበሉ ሲሆን፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ደግሞ በአካባቢው ለተፈጠረው ግጭት ኢራንን ተጠያቂ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Embaasiin Ameerikaa Riyaad jiru, haleellaa rookeettii fi xiyyaara malee fe’umsaa garee Huutii hordofee, hojjettoonni barbaachisoo hin taane fi maatiin isaanii Sa’udii Arabiyaa gadhiisanii akka bahan gorseera. Gama biraatiin, Israa’el giddii October 2023 booda yeroo jalqabaaf filannoo biyyoolessaa geggeessaa jirti; lammiileen miiliyoona torba ol ta’an sagalee kennuuf qophiidha. Akkasumas, Muummeen Ministiraa Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu hogganaa waraanaa hojiirraa ari’uuf karoorfateera jedhamee kan afarfame kijiba ta’uu ibsaniiru; Doolaard Traampis walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa keessatti Iran qooda akka qabdu dubbataniiru.

title: US issues security alert for Americans in Saudi Arabia
english: The U.S. government has ordered non-emergency staff and their families to depart Saudi Arabia due to growing security concerns. This decision follows recent attacks on airports by Iranian-backed Houthis, which have led to flight cancellations and airspace instability. American citizens remaining in the country are advised to exercise extreme caution when traveling and to verify their flight statuses directly with airlines.

Murtii kana kan dabarse garee Huthotaa kanneen Iraaniin deeggaramanifi naannichatti buufataalee xiyyaaraa irratti weerara geggeessaa jiran hordofeeti. title: UN chief warns of a growing threat of ethnic cleansing in West Bank
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has expressed serious concern regarding the escalation of Israeli settler activity and violence against Palestinians in the West Bank. He warned that the region is facing an increasingly hostile atmosphere that raises the alarming possibility of ethnic cleansing. Guterres emphasized that these trends create a dangerous situation for the local population.

oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomani Antonio Guterres, babal'achuu qubata Israa'eloota fi gocha haleellaa naannoo West Bank keessatti Palestayinoota irratti raawwatamaa jiruun walqabatee yaaddoo cimaa qaban ibsaniiru. Namni kun haalli naannichaa gara bakka namoonni sanyiin qulqulleeffamaniitti (ethnic cleansing) geessuu danda'uufi sodaachisaa ta'aa dhufeera jedhaniiru. Guterres haalli kun uummata naannichaaaf balaa guddaa akka qabu dhaamaniiru.

title: Polls open in Israel
english: Israel has officially started its first general election since October 7, 2023, with voting centers opening across the country early this morning. Approximately 7.3 million citizens are registered to participate in this national vote. Polls will remain accessible to the public until 10 p.m. local time today.
amharic: እስራኤል ከጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2023 ወዲህ የመጀመሪያውን ጠቅላላ ምርጫ ዛሬ ማለዳ ላይ በይፋ ጀምራለች። በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በሚካሄደው በዚህ የምርጫ ሂደት ወደ 7.3 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ መራጮች ድምፅ ለመስጠት ብቁ ናቸው። የምርጫ ጣቢያዎች እስከ ምሽቱ 4 ሰዓት ድረስ ክፍት ሆነው ይቆያሉ።
oromo: Israa'el filannoo guutuu biyyaa kan jalqabaa erga Onkoloolessa 7, 2023 gaggeessite guyyaa har'aa ganama eegaluu ishee beekameera. Namoonni miiliyoona 7.3 ta'an sagalee kennuuf kan galmaa'an yoo ta'u, filannoon kun guutuu biyyattii keessatti adeemsifamaa jira. Buufataleen sagalee kennuuf gargaaran halkan sa'aatii afurtti (10 pm) hanga cufamanitti sagalee kennuun ni danda'ama.

title: Trump claims Iran 'started' war with US
english: Former US President Donald Trump stated that Iran is the aggressor in the ongoing conflict with the United States. He dismissed a previous ceasefire as ineffective and a waste of effort. Additionally, Trump expressed concern regarding Iran's missile technology, warning that it poses a direct threat to major American cities.
amharic: ቀድሞ የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት የነበሩት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ለሚካሄደው ግጭት ኢራንን ተጠያቂ አድርገዋል። ቀደም ሲል የተደረገውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ጊዜን በከንቱ ማባከን ነው ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። በተጨማሪም ኢራን አሜሪካን የመምታት አቅም ያላቸው ሚሳኤሎች እንዳሏት በመጥቀስ፣ ይህም ለትላልቅ የአሜሪካ ከተሞች ስጋት መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidantiin Amerika duraanii Donaald Tiraamp, waraana biyyasaanii fi Iraan gidduutti godhamaa jiru keessatti Iraan akka taate itti gaafatamtuu ibsaniiru. title: Bolsonaro’s party accepts Brazil election after Trump calls vote ‘rigged’
english: Brazil's Liberal Party has officially acknowledged Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's victory in the recent presidential election, despite initial opposition from Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and his camp. While the party leader admitted the election results are valid, he still called for further investigation into concerns raised during the voting process. Former President Bolsonaro has not yet formally conceded and is pursuing legal challenges regarding voting hours, even as his party moves to accept the outcome.

Pirezidaantiin duraanii Bolsonaaroon hanga ammaa injifatamuu isaanii ifatti hin fudhanne akkasumas sa'aatii filannoo irratti falmii seeraa kan qaban ta'us, paartiin isaanii garuu bu'ichaa fudhachuuf murteesseera.

title: Serbia’s ‘students’ celebrate for a second night after election victory
english: Thousands of people in Belgrade, Serbia, spent a second consecutive night celebrating a major election win led by a student-driven movement. The results of the parliamentary vote successfully unseated the political party previously headed by former president Aleksandar Vucic. This protest movement has now achieved a significant political shift within the country.

title: Romania says Russia-run sabotage network set fire near weapons factory
english: Romanian authorities have identified a Russian-led sabotage group responsible for a fire at an industrial site near a weapons factory in Brasov this September. Officials believe this incident is part of an ongoing campaign by Moscow to destabilize European nations supporting Ukraine through vandalism and intimidation. Two suspects from Belarus and Ukraine were arrested in Germany while allegedly planning further attacks, following a recruitment pattern that often begins with small online tasks before escalating to serious criminal acts.

title: Trump administration illegally fired James Comey's daughter, judge rules
english: A federal judge has ruled that the Trump administration acted unlawfully when it fired federal prosecutor Maurene Comey, the daughter of former FBI Director James Comey. The court determined her dismissal violated her constitutional rights and the proper legal procedures for removing prosecutors, as her firing was likely motivated by political bias rather than her professional performance. Consequently, the government has been ordered to reinstate her and provide back pay for the period she was unemployed.

oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa tokko mootummaan Donald Trump intala duraanii daayrektara FBI James Comey kan taate, Maurene Comey hojii irraa ari'uun isaa seeraan alaa akka ta'e murteesseera. title: Former FBI director James Comey hit with third set of charges under Trump
english: Former FBI Director James Comey is facing his third set of criminal accusations from the Trump administration, this time involving claims that he leaked classified national security information to the media. While Comey has not been formally indicted, prosecutors allege he directed subordinates to share sensitive defense details with a reporter in 2016. Comey maintains his innocence, describing the ongoing legal actions as a politically motivated effort by the government to retaliate against a vocal critic.

title: What will Lula’s fourth term mean for Brazil?
english: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has secured a historic fourth nonconsecutive term as president of Brazil after winning a closely contested runoff election. While he campaigned on a promise of significant national change, his victory is currently being challenged by his opponent, Flavio Bolsonaro.
